name: Amara
self_text: Hi, I'm Amara! I love the atmosphere of Hollow Lantern and play ranked matches on PC. I'm available on weekday evenings or Saturday mornings. I use text chat only and don't do coaching. Outside of gaming, I really enjoy watching old westerns.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into Hollow Lantern and you have to be into ranked matches. I'd strongly prefer that we overlap on text chat, though it's not a requirement. It would matter a lot if you are available Saturday morning or weekday evenings, but I won't rule you out over it.
